scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: composer --working-dir=api install && npm --prefix api install && (test -f api/.env || cp api/.env.example api/.env) && (grep -q '^APP_KEY=.\{10,\}' api/.env || php api/artisan key:generate) && (test -f api/database/database.sqlite || touch api/database/database.sqlite) && php api/artisan migrate
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
